description: This file defines a SkipTagsAggregator class that extends a simple text aggregator to prevent sentence boundary detection within specified start/end tags. It is used for processing text data where certain tagged content should be treated as a single sentence unit, regardless of internal punctuation.

classes.name: SkipTagsAggregator
classes.description: An aggregator that buffers text and prevents sentence boundary detection inside specified start/end tags, extending SimpleTextAggregator.

methods.name: __init__(self, tags: Sequence[StartEndTags])
methods.description: Initializes the aggregator with a sequence of StartEndTags defining the tags to prevent sentence splitting.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[Aggregation] aggregate(self, text: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes input text character-by-character, respecting tag boundaries, and yields aggregated sentence segments.

methods.name: handle_interruption(self)
methods.description: Handles interruptions by clearing the buffer and resetting tag state.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Clears internal buffer and tag state, resetting the aggregator.

ctags.name: aggregate
ctags.pattern: /^    async def aggregate(self, text: str) -> AsyncIterator[Aggregation]:$/
